description: This file defines data structures and constants for Kubernetes node and pod statistics, including CPU, memory, IO, network, filesystem, and accelerator metrics, used for monitoring and resource management.

classes.name: Summary
classes.description: Top-level container for NodeStats and PodStats.

classes.name: NodeStats
classes.description: Holds node-level unprocessed sample stats including CPU, memory, IO, network, filesystem, runtime, rlimit, and swap.

classes.name: PodStats
classes.description: Holds pod-level unprocessed sample stats including container stats, CPU, memory, IO, network, volume, ephemeral storage, process, and swap.

classes.name: ContainerStats
classes.description: Holds container-level unprocessed sample stats including CPU, memory, IO, accelerators, filesystem, user metrics, and swap.

classes.name: PodReference
classes.description: Contains info to locate a pod (name, namespace, UID).

classes.name: NetworkStats
classes.description: Data about network resources, including interface stats.

classes.name: AcceleratorStats
classes.description: Stats for hardware accelerators attached to containers.

classes.name: UserDefinedMetricType
classes.description: Defines how user metrics should be interpreted.

classes.name: UserDefinedMetric
classes.description: A user-defined metric with value and timestamp.
